comment: After creating metrics, resolve IDs by metric_name and attach them to the scope object's logic_properties. metric.scope_ref must equal the object type ID. Class-level counts need no instance parameters; stock, forecasts and orders use object properties as filters. Omit instant/start/end/step because the system adds them.

logic_properties.name: product_total_count
logic_properties.comment: Class-level finished product count. Use metric query for values; discover the metric through product logic properties.

logic_properties.name: material_total_count
logic_properties.comment: Class-level material count; filter by material type or stock category.

parameters.name: materialattr
parameters.comment: Material type: Purchased / Manufactured / Subcontracted / Phantom.

logic_properties.name: supplier_total_count
logic_properties.comment: Class-level supplier count; supports buyer filters.

logic_properties.name: sales_order_count
logic_properties.comment: Order count; use product_code for an instance and optionally filter order_status.

logic_properties.name: signed_quantity_sum
logic_properties.comment: Aggregate sales quantity; filter by product code.

logic_properties.name: shipped_quantity_sum
logic_properties.comment: Aggregate sales quantity; filter by product code.

logic_properties.name: signed_quantity_by_date
logic_properties.comment: Signing event quantity. Objects default to the product all-time total; use the fixed historical examples for time analysis.

logic_properties.name: warehouse_count
logic_properties.comment: Distinct warehouses in stock records, regardless of the production_available preset.

logic_properties.name: available_qty_sum
logic_properties.comment: sum(available_inventory_qty). Expand warehouse presets with warehouse in at query time; keep them out of the metric definition.

parameters.name: warehouse
parameters.comment: Warehouse list; expand the finished_goods or production_available preset here.

parameters.name: stock_status
parameters.comment: Stock status; often defaults to Available.

logic_properties.name: forecast_qty_sum
logic_properties.comment: sum(qty). Add a closestatus_title filter for open forecasts.

parameters.name: closestatus_title
parameters.comment: Closure status. For open forecasts, use Open or != Closed.

logic_properties.name: open_forecast_count
logic_properties.comment: Definition-level condition is discarded by the deployed API. Queries must include closestatus_title != Closed or == Open.

parameters.name: closestatus_title
parameters.comment: Closure status; query open records with Closed and operation !=.
